memory.feedback: All supplied development runs reached the 1100-action limit without success; scores alone do not identify specific grasp or planning failures.
reusable_lessons: Bound execution and avoid uncertain manipulation retries.
Parse scene keys at the last underscore; preserve string categories.
Assign distinct baskets to categories, preserving unambiguous existing contents.
Refresh RGB observations before each transfer and match objects spatially rather than treating names as persistent identities.
Normalize tool quaternions and use elevated approach, lift, transport, release, and retreat waypoints.

rationale: The policy replaces potentially unbounded behavior with a finite, observation-driven sorting pass. It uses only the supplied scene, approach, and gripper primitives, maintains one basket per category, and stops on unavailable perception or manipulation exceptions. The feedback supports addressing action-budget exhaustion but does not establish its cause or demonstrate that this policy succeeds.
